artifact_groups.rationale: Evolution as optimization without gradient: Carl Sims creatures and evolving flowers shaped by selection pressure. Artifacts pending placement from root-level groups.
Navigating loss surfaces: gradient descent visualization and PCA dimensionality reduction. Seeing high-dimensional landscapes. Artifacts pending placement.
Three ways to draw boundaries in data: K-means clustering, SVM, random forest. Different strategies for the same fundamental question. Artifacts pending placement.
Layers learn features: neural network visualization and architecture exploration. From input to output, each layer extracts progressively abstract representations. Artifacts pending placement.
How machines learn to see: computer vision, CNNs, attention mechanisms. Specialized perception — convolution as learned pattern matching. Artifacts pending placement.
Temporal patterns and long-range dependencies: LSTMs gate memory, transformers attend across sequences. Learning to remember what matters. Artifacts pending placement.
Machines that generate, not just classify: GANs and VAEs learn distributions and sample new instances. Creation from learned probability. Artifacts pending placement.
Reinforcement learning agents that act, explainable AI we can question, anomaly detection that finds the unexpected. ML paradigm synthesis. Artifacts pending placement.
